dz: 德干苏丹国在塔里科塔之战中击败毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的罗摩拉亚，造成十万多人伤亡，首都毗奢耶那伽罗被毁。
de: The Deccan Sultanates defeat Rama Raya of the Vijayanagara Empire at the Battle of Talikota, resulting in over 100,000 casualties and the destruction of the capital Vijayanagara.

t: 宿迁建立后成为菲律宾第一个西班牙人定居地.
te: Cebu is established becoming the first Spanish settlement in the Philippines.
dz: 宿迁建立后成为菲律宾第一个西班牙人定居地.
de: Cebu is established becoming the first Spanish settlement in the Philippines.

t: 马耳他大围城开始,奥斯曼军队试图并未能征服马耳他.
te: The Great Siege of Malta begins, in which Ottoman forces attempt and fail to conquer Malta.
dz: 马耳他大围城开始,奥斯曼军队试图并未能征服马耳他.
de: The Great Siege of Malta begins, in which Ottoman forces attempt and fail to conquer Malta.

t: 奥斯曼海军司令德拉古特在马耳他大围攻中战死.
te: Dragut, commander of the Ottoman navy, dies during the Great Siege of Malta.
dz: 奥斯曼海军司令德拉古特在马耳他大围攻中战死.
de: Dragut, commander of the Ottoman navy, dies during the Great Siege of Malta.

te: The widowed Mary, Queen of Scots marries Henry Stuart, Lord Darnley, Duke of Albany, at Holyrood Palace, Edinburgh, Sco…
dz: 寡居的玛丽,苏格兰女王与亨利·斯图亚特(英语:Henry Stuart),奥尔巴尼公爵达恩利(英语:Dernley (Dernley))相接,在苏格兰爱丁堡的神圣宫殿举行天主教仪式.
de: The widowed Mary, Queen of Scots marries Henry Stuart, Lord Darnley, Duke of Albany, at Holyrood Palace, Edinburgh, Scotland, in a Catholic ceremony.

t: 佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯在佛罗里达州圣奥古斯丁附近看到了陆地并发现了美国大陆上最古老的被持…
te: Pedro Menéndez de Avilés sights land near St. Augustine, Florida and founds the oldest continuously occupied European-e…
dz: 佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯在佛罗里达州圣奥古斯丁附近看到了陆地并发现了美国大陆上最古老的被持续占领的欧洲建制城市.
de: Pedro Menéndez de Avilés sights land near St. Augustine, Florida and founds the oldest continuously occupied European-established city in the continental United States.

t: 由西班牙腓特烈二世出使至马耳他大围城的所谓"大索克索"("大解脱")到达.
te: Arrival of the so-called Grande Soccorso ("great relief") by Philip II of Spain to the Great Siege of Malta.
dz: 由西班牙腓特烈二世出使至马耳他大围城的所谓"大索克索"("大解脱")到达.
de: Arrival of the so-called Grande Soccorso ("great relief") by Philip II of Spain to the Great Siege of Malta.

t: 佛罗里达州圣奥古斯丁由西班牙上将和佛罗里达州首任州长佩德罗·梅内德斯·德·阿维莱斯所建立.
te: St. Augustine, Florida is founded by Spanish admiral and Florida's first governor, Pedro Menéndez de Avilés.
dz: 佛罗里达州圣奥古斯丁由西班牙上将和佛罗里达州首任州长佩德罗·梅内德斯·德·阿维莱斯所建立.
de: St. Augustine, Florida is founded by Spanish admiral and Florida's first governor, Pedro Menéndez de Avilés.

t: 奥斯曼军队从马耳他撤退,结束了马耳他的大围攻.
te: Ottoman forces retreat from Malta ending the Great Siege of Malta.
dz: 奥斯曼军队从马耳他撤退,结束了马耳他的大围攻.
de: Ottoman forces retreat from Malta ending the Great Siege of Malta.

t: 日本松原一族所属舰艇在福田湾战役中未能攻克葡萄牙贸易卡克,这是日本与西方第一次有记载的海战.
te: Ships belonging to the Matsura clan of Japan fail to capture the Portuguese trading carrack in the Battle of Fukuda Bay…
dz: 日本松原一族所属舰艇在福田湾战役中未能攻克葡萄牙贸易卡克,这是日本与西方第一次有记载的海战.
de: Ships belonging to the Matsura clan of Japan fail to capture the Portuguese trading carrack in the Battle of Fukuda Bay, the first recorded naval battle between Japan and the West.
